# Checkpoint

Implemented `extra_suffixes_workaround` in `qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py` for Qt runtime versions 6.2.3 through 6.6.x. Added focused tests in `tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py` for version bounds, specific MIME types, wildcard types, and existing suffixes.

+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return file suffixes missing from Qt's accepted file types.
+
+    Work around Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x omitting some MIME type extensions
+    from the file picker filter.
+    """
+    if (not qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) or
+            qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    accepted = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = set()
+    for mime in accepted:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return suffixes - accepted
+
+

diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
index 98bf34f..2d3cafd 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 
 import re
 import dataclasses
+import mimetypes
 
 import pytest
 webview = pytest.importorskip('qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webview')
@@ -58,3 +59,51 @@ def test_enum_mappings(enum_type, naming, mapping):
     for name, val in members:
         mapped = mapping[val]
         assert camel_to_snake(naming, name) == mapped.name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lower, upper, expected", [
+    (False, False, set()),
+    (True, True, set()),
+    (True, False, {".jpg", ".jpe", ".png", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}),
+])
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_versions(mocker, lower, upper, expected):
+    version_check = mocker.patch.object(webview.qtutils, "version_check")
+    version_check.side_effect = lambda version, compiled: {
+        "6.2.3": lower, "6.7.0": upper,
+    }[version]
+    mocker.patch.object(webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions", side_effect=lambda mime: {
+        "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+        "image/png": [".png"],
+        "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+    }[mime])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "video/mp4"]
+    ) == expected
+    assert all(call.kwargs == {"compiled": False}
+               for call in version_check.call_args_list)
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_wildcard(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        side_effect=lambda version, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+    mocker.patch.object(mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png", ".mp4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/*", ".jpg"]
+    ) == {".jpe", ".png"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_existing_suffixes(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        side_effect=lambda version, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+    mocker.patch.object(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        return_value=[".jpg", ".jpe"])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]
+    ) == set()
